newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss mountain cable car plunge kills one, hurts 18.
newsitem.headline: Swiss mountain cable car plunge kills one, hurts 18.

text.p: One person died and 18 others were hurt, two of them seriously, when several gondolas on a Swiss mountain cable car crashed to the ground on Saturday, police said.
"One person is dead," said Carlo Kuonen, police spokesman in the southwestern canton of Valais, but he did not identify the victim.
Another 18 were hurt in the mishap in Riederalp, but some had already been treated and released from hospital, he said.
"I don't have the final list, but the victims are predominantly Swiss," he added.
Police blamed the accident on a malfunction, but the exact cause was still under investigation.
Victims were flown by helicopter to hospitals in the area after the accident around 0900 GMT.
